implemented_capabilities.capability: Reliance-weighted dependency-risk propagation along citation chains to a retracted root (proven vs possible risk)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Iterative Cypher passes (one per hop) write Paper.risk (possible, UNKNOWN edges at 0.3) and Paper.risk_proven (evidence only); a reduce()-based CHAIN query returns the riskiest path with per-link evidence; check() cross-verifies propagate against brute-force path enumeration; import-time assert keeps the weight tiers consistent.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Per-citation reliance classification from citation sentences (LLM answers, fixed rules decide class and weight)
implemented_capabilities.notes: The LLM answers yes/no questions plus a sentence index; classify() maps them to CRITICAL/FOUNDATIONAL/SUPPORTING/BACKGROUND/UNKNOWN with deterministic rules (3+ reference lists demote to BACKGROUND), and the evidence sentence is copied verbatim; judged_by records provider:model:version and judged_at. Quality depends on LLM answers.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Carry check: does dependence survive a hop (two-model agreement that the next paper relies on the part taken from the retracted root)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Two independent model families vote; carries=true only if both say yes, false only if both no, else null; links not shown to carry count at most as a passing mention in risk_proven. Results stored on edges with carry_votes, carry_evidence, carry_by, carry_at and versioned (c5) so re-judging is idempotent.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Foundation check verdicts with evidence-bounded tiers and coverage accounting
implemented_capabilities.notes: Verdicts RESTS ON RETRACTED WORK / NOT PROVEN / CITES RETRACTED WORK / NO RETRACTED WORK FOUND / CLEAN . DEPTH 2 / NO DATA; never claims clean when references could not be checked; whole BibTeX/reference lists supported within a credit budget; results stored as :Investigation nodes with the full JSON for later replay.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Retraction ingestion and citation graph loading (OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar sentences, Retraction Watch)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Cached, rate-limited, retrying HTTP fetchers; UNWIND/MERGE batch upserts of Paper nodes and CITES edges; Retraction nodes linked via RETRACTS; citation context sentences stored on edges.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Read-only serving layer: web UI API and MCP server with ALLOW_RUNS gate
implemented_capabilities.notes: Three MCP tools over a hand-written JSON-RPC stdio loop; web API with request semaphore, body-size caps and Cache-Control no-store; any write path (new checks, re-propagation) is refused when ALLOW_RUNS=0.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Autonomous exploration agent and human-agreement scoring
implemented_capabilities.notes: Agent expands papers whose possible risk >= EXPLORE (0.05) and records Investigation/EXPLORED edges; humancheck samples links for manual labels and scores model agreement; not read in full by the auditor.
Pages nodes and edges by internal ID into a gzip JSONL with a count manifest and replays them into another FalkorDB; preflight runs 13 deployment checks.

graph_models_and_cypher: Nodes: Paper {id, doi, title, year, retracted, risk, risk_proven, risk_root, refs, type}, Retraction {record_id}, Investigation {id, mode, root, verdict, result(JSON)}; transient label :Contaminated for papers proven to build on the root. Edges: CITES {cls, reliance, evidence, why, contexts, judged_by, judged_at, carries, carry_root, carry_votes, carry_evidence, carry_why, carry_by, carry_at}, RETRACTS, EXPLORED. Cypher patterns: iterative max(prop*weight) relaxation per hop, variable-length CITES*1..3 with all(c IN relationships(p)) filters and reduce() path scoring, UNWIND batch SET, CALL db.indexes(). Pure OpenCypher plus FalkorDB ro_query timeouts; no APOC/GDS. Property names are interpolated by f-string from internal constants (risk/risk_proven) only.
algorithms: Max-product risk relaxation over CITES, one pass per hop up to MAX_HOPS=3 (shaky/risk.py:propagate)
Riskiest chain extraction with deterministic tie-breaking via reduce() and ORDER BY risk DESC, length, id string (shaky/risk.py:chain)
Brute-force verification of propagate vs all chains (shaky/risk.py:check)
Two-model consensus carry decision with unclear handling (shaky/carry.py:_combine)
Citation-class rules incl. reference-list-size demotion via regex count_refs (shaky/judge.py)
Evidence-bounded verdict tiering with coverage completeness (shaky/foundation.py:_tier, check)
backend_interfaces: stdlib HTTP server (shaky/web.py): GET /api/config, /api/blast, /api/paper, /api/edge, /api/checks, /api/check; POST /api/check, /api/list (write paths need ALLOW_RUNS=1)
MCP stdio server (shaky/mcp_server.py): check_foundations, retraction_blast_radius, explain_chain
CLI modules: db, load, evidence, judge, carry, risk, agent, report, foundation, snapshot, preflight, bench, humancheck
frontend_interfaces: web/index.html + app.js + style.css: blast-radius graph view, paper/edge evidence panels, foundation-check tab with reference-list upload
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: Investigation nodes persist full foundation-check results (replayable, listed by /api/checks); agent.py expands the graph autonomously and records EXPLORED edges; LLM judgments are cached on disk by prompt hash and versioned on edges (judge v3, carry c5) so judgments are reproducible and re-run only when the version bumps. Not a conversational memory.
tests_present: tests/test_rules.py: 17 offline unittest cases (no network, no database) covering DOI/ID resolution, reference-list parsing, reliance classification order, BUILDS_ON threshold separation, carry vote combination, crosscheck rules, MCP protocol handshake/errors; GitHub Actions runs them via uv. The Cypher propagation itself is only verified by risk.check() against a live FalkorDB. Not executed by auditor.
dependency_requirements: OPENALEX_API_KEY, S2_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY (data and judging stages only)
security_findings: shaky/config.py:23 - ALLOW_RUNS defaults to 1, so by default the unauthenticated web API and MCP server can trigger graph writes and spend OpenAlex/LLM credits; public deployments must set ALLOW_RUNS=0
shaky/web.py:131-146 - POST endpoints have size caps but no authentication or rate limiting beyond a request semaphore; binds 127.0.0.1 by default (HOST env can widen)

shaky/db.py:40, shaky/risk.py:140, shaky/snapshot.py:47-49,116, shaky/views.py:69 - f-string Cypher; interpolated parts are constants (labels, property names, patterns) while user values travel as $params; not injectable as written
shaky/llm.py:42-60 - API keys sent as Bearer headers; error text is scrubbed with replace(key, '<key>'); LLM responses cached on disk (data/cache/llm) including full model output
shaky/fetch.py:~10 - httpx logger lowered to WARNING because it would log URLs with keys (positive mitigation)
examples/cite_check_agent.py:78 - subprocess.Popen starts the MCP server as a child with a fixed command; example only
No eval/exec/pickle; no hard-coded secrets (.env.example is empty); outbound hosts limited to OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, Retraction Watch CSV and Gemini/Groq endpoints
duplicates_or_overlaps: Overlaps ibnweb3/bedrock (retracted-citation exposure) but goes much further with reliance-weighted multi-hop risk; family overlap with lineage / provenance and supersession engines; chain extraction overlaps blast-radius traversal.
evidence_drift_relevance: HIGH - implements dependency invalidation with edge-level provenance: invalidation of an upstream root propagates through reliance-weighted chains, every link carries verbatim evidence plus judged_by/judged_at/version, a proven-vs-possible split refuses to overstate, and carry votes require two-model agreement before dependence passes a hop.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: A self-contained, FalkorDB-native engine for propagating invalidation along evidence-weighted dependency edges with two honesty levels (possible vs proven), deterministic chain explanation and a brute-force self-check; the weights table and tier invariants map directly onto an Evidence Drift Cascade (swap CITES for DERIVED_FROM / RELIES_ON and retracted for superseded).
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: FalkorDB (falkordb Python client); no LLM needed for propagation itself, LLM only for reliance/carry judgments in judge.py and carry.py

strategy_rationale: risk.py plus reliance.py is a generic weighted invalidation-propagation core that Kairos can adopt as a shared engine for evidence drift; judge/carry become optional pluggable judges. The OpenAlex/Retraction Watch loaders stay in a Research Evidence capability pack.
